name: Ohio class SSBN
note: US Navy Ohio-class ballistic-missile submarine. Each SSBN carries 20 Trident II D5 SLBMs (reduced from 24 tubes under New START). Trident II range commonly cited ~12,000 km. Displacement 18,750 t submerged; two alternating crews fly ~70-90 day patrols.

name: Borei class SSBN

name: Arihant class SSBN
note: Indian Navy Arihant-class ballistic-missile submarine. The Arihant subclass has 4 SLBM tubes; each can hold the K-4 (3,500 km) or three K-15 (~750 km) missiles. Displacement ~6,000 t; complement 95.
